claimBoundary: Questionnaire-independent within the published integer single-choice profile and allowlisted workflows/scorers. The no-code and reviewed-import paths support 1-20 items on one shared integer scale with mean, sum and optional reverse scoring. The platform is not compatible with every questionnaire and does not establish permission, psychometric validity, equivalence, full WCAG conformance or disability-group benefit.
